Ben Bederson
Benjamin" Ben" Bederson is a Computer Science professor at the University of Maryland, College Park, a member of the University of Maryland Human- Computer Interaction Lab, and a co-founder of Zumobi. His father is Benjamin Bederson, Sr., a Professor of Physics Emeritus, New York University.
